description: Source code for HTTP/2 header compression (HPACK) implementation, including encoding and decoding functions, static and dynamic table management, Huffman encoding, and related utilities.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_init
methods.description: Initializes the header encoder, setting up tables and internal state.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources allocated by the encoder.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_use_hist
methods.description: Enables or disables header name/value history tracking.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_hist_used
methods.description: Checks if header history tracking is enabled.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_set_max_capacity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity for the dynamic table.

methods.name: lshpack_enc_encode
methods.description: Encodes a header into the HPACK format.

methods.name: lshpack_dec_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources allocated by the decoder.

methods.name: lshpack_dec_set_max_capacity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity for the dynamic table in decoding.

methods.name: lshpack_dec_decode
methods.description: Decodes HPACK-encoded header data into header fields.
